title: A Multi-Instance LLM Framework for Rating the Quality of Surgical Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2605.25440v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Verbal feedback delivered by attending surgeons in the operating room plays a critical formative role in resident trainee skill acquisition. Yet, assessing the quality of trainer feedback and its effectiveness in influencing trainee behavior during live surgery remains a challenge. Prior studies assessed feedback content relying on extensive manual annotation by expert human raters and focused on developing broad taxonomies that overlook the qualitative aspects of feedback delivery such as clarity or urgency. Limited existing automated methods, including keyword analysis and topic modeling, also fail to capture these nuanced aspects. We introduce a two-stage LLM-based framework that discovers interpretable feedback quality criteria grounded in the context of surgical training. translated_title: 一种用于评估手术反馈质量的多实例大语言模型框架
translated_abstract: 主治外科医生在手术室中提供的口头反馈对住院医师学员的技能习得起着关键的形成性作用。然而，在真实手术过程中评估培训者反馈的质量及其影响学员行为的有效性仍然是一项挑战。先前的研究依赖专家人工评分者进行大量手动标注来评估反馈内容，并专注于构建宽泛的分类体系，而忽略了反馈传递的定性方面，例如清晰度或紧迫性。现有为数不多的自动化方法（包括关键词分析和主题建模）也无法捕捉这些细微的方面。我们提出了一个基于大语言模型的两阶段框架，该框架能够在手术培训的背景下发现可解释的反馈质量评估标准。我们的方法通过重复独立采样候选标准并加以整合的方式使用多实例提示，并注入外科领域知识……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的两阶段多实例提示框架，通过对候选质量标准进行重复独立采样与整合并注入外科领域知识，自动发现可解释的手术反馈质量评估标准，解决了手术培训中口头反馈质量难以评估的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a two-stage multi-instance LLM framework that discovers interpretable criteria for rating the quality of verbal surgical feedback, addressing the challenge of assessing trainer feedback quality and its effectiveness in surgical training.
